neighbours.label: a retrospective time reference that points back to a past moment in a narrative ('at the time', 'back then', 'the then minister'), as against 'time' and 'then' that do not refer back to a past moment
fire: My grandfather was only a teenager at the time, so he stayed on the farm.
The phone was the smallest model sold in the shops at the time, she recalled.
We lived above a bakery at the time and woke to the smell of bread.
He played for a small club at the time and earned very little money.
Back then, most families in the valley kept a few chickens.
That chip was the fastest one available at the time, the engineer said.
She was working as a nurse in Leeds at the time of the flood.
The bridge was the longest in Europe at the time it opened.
quiet: My grandfather says it is time to sell the farm and move to town.
The phone is the smallest model sold in the shops today, she says.
We live above a bakery and wake to the smell of bread each day.
He plays for a small club and earns very little money these days.
Every time the bus is late, the families in the valley complain.
